title: Need better design
text: Need better design. How does Bissell design a vacuum that won’t vacuum? This thing is very loud and just pushes dirt around the floor. I’ve tried all the settings but still no luck. It has good suction but if it can’t get to the dirt or whatever it’s useless. 6 year old dyson out vacuum this thing easy. It’s also like 30% heavier than the dyson. Attachments work well but if it can’t vacuum with the main brush it’s not very helpful. Very strange a brand like Bissell releases this to production.  I’ve tried it on tile floors as well a carpet. It works marginally better on carpet but still way too many passes needed to pick up simple things.

description: BISSELL® ICONPET® family of stick vacuums just welcomed its most powerful member: ICONPET® TURBO EDGE 25V cordless vacuum. This cordless stick vac is engineered with a special Turbo Boost Mode to provide enhanced suction power. It also has a powerful High-Performance Digital Motor and a 25V lithium-ion battery which provides up to 50 minutes of cordless cleaning.* And with a Tangle-Free Brush Roll that actively prevents hair wrap, you don’t have to worry about hair getting wrapped around the brush roll. ICONPET® TURBO EDGE cordless vacuum easily converts to a handheld or high-reach vacuum and works with specialized tools to provide the ultimate whole-home cleaning experience. LED lights illuminate pet hair while cleaning and a full-width suction foot captures debris along tight edges and corners. When you're done cleaning, features like the washable filter, Easy Empty™ Dirt Tank with CleanSlide™ Technology and parking brake make maintaining and storing this machine a breeze. BISSELL proudly supports BISSELL Pet Foundation® and its mission to help save homeless pets. When you buy a BISSELL product, you help save pets, too. We’re proud to design products that help make pet messes, odors and pet homelessness disappear.
